steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Alright, let's wrap it up!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Does it still hurt?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Nope. Never been better.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Looks like your arm has made a complete recovery. The Wind Knight suddenly forfeiting was a huge help.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret! I've finished upgrading your swordspear!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I tried incorporating some Minoan techniques: maintaining excellent Arts transmission on one side, and using a special polymer coat to improve concentration on the other––

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: In any case, this'll make your weapon both lighter and sharper!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hah, used just about everything in my shop to boot.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: You have my assurances, this is the best sword– err, lance? Right, swordspear, that we've ever made.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: The sword you won your first championship with was the second best. And that warhammer you took with you was the third best.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hah, don't mention it!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Zofia, these are all the records I've found on the Blood Knight's matches.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Good. Time is of the essence.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Margaret, we have to go into this fully prepared. Margaret?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Thank you... All of you, for supporting me.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: This may well be our final mission, Monique.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Yeah, I know.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Are we really going to attack the Radiant Knight?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: The Board is still split. We'll have Platinum do the dirty work.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: And Darksteel also authorized the attack? Why? After this is over, why would we still be concerned with the Radiant Knight?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I don't know. Maybe Darksteel felt threatened by the Radiant Knight... Since the Board is on the same page, that works out nicely.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: They're already wary of us. Until Darksteel gives us the signal, we would do well to avoid exposing ourselves.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: In any case, let's just pray that the Blood Knight can defeat the Radiant Knight. That'd make things a whole lot easier for all of us.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Who do you think has a better chance of winning?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: It's hard to say...

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: I, I'm going to be the commentator for the finals? Me?!

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: The numbers don't lie, Mob. You are now one of the top tournament commentators. Congratulations.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Additionally, you've been a part of the Nearl sisters' story since Maria. The Board of Directors also sees this as a selling point, and hopes to work with you more.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Have you seen the latest issue of 'Knights Illustrated?' You've been dubbed 'The Voice That Walks With the Light.' You're now a household name.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: R-Really?!!

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: And lest we forget... Your bonus will be credited to your account tomorrow. There will be something else for you, after the Major.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Does that mean I'll finally be able to bring my parents to the Grand Knight Territory?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Of course. You could buy them a huge villa, if you want.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...tickets... to the finals?

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Rhodes Island's help has been instrumental to this year's Kazimierz Major. We've learned much from you in terms of dealing with Oripathy.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: The winner of this year's Major will be decided between the Radiant Knight and the Blood Knight—a final match between two Infected.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: As such, I believe that Rhodes Island should be there to watch this unprecedented final match.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Also, if I'm not mistaken, those two Sarkaz ladies over there are quite close to Margaret, yes?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Thank you for your generosity.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Nearl... She'll win, right?

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: You'll have to see for yourself, young lady.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So we have four tickets...

options: As leaders of Rhodes Island, we can't afford to miss this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You have to come with me too, Doctor!

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: And naturally, I'll have to come along to ensure Doctor's safety.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That leaves us with two...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I really want to see Nearl's dazzling performance, but the medic team is kind of tied down...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But! Doctor, Amiya, you two should go for sure!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: And if Shining and Nightingale go as well, that makes four!

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I can't just leave the medic team like that.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: The Major is about to end anyway, so there aren't as many people who need treatment!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Besides, didn't the Doctor do a wonderful job for the Infected here? I imagine the situation will be pretty stable for a while–

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: If I were in Nearl's shoes, I'd be heartbroken if none of my friends came to support me during the finals!

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Hehe, you have a point.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Liz, do you want to see Nearl's victory?

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Mhm...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Doctor, Amiya... Please allow us to join you.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The finals are between the Blood Knight and the Radiant Knight

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: No matter who wins... the next champion will be one of us.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: The Area 0 conspiracy has been brought to light, and the one behind it has stepped down. The Adeptus Sprawiedliwi has promised you asylum, and you can start your life anew.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: It really is a fairytale ending, huh?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: ––But that's not really the case, is it?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Looking at today's news, discussions about the Infected continue. The Armorless can be dealt with. The K.G.C.C. can be dealt with. But how can we deal with the public's fear of Oripathy?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: You fought against the K.G.C.C. and the Union. But the latter is just a group of sellswords, and the former is the foundation of modern Kazimierz.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Flametail Knight, Sona.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Is this all it takes?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Something's been on my mind recently, Toland. Since you aren't from the Grand Knight Territory, you might have a better sense of this than we do.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Can we really improve the lives of the Infected just by defeating the K.G.C.C. and the Armorless Union?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Honestly, can we even really defeat the K.G.C.C.?

a.text: One who competes for wealth and glory.

steps.name: A Commentator
steps.text: A Minoan clad in blood-red armor! A warrior from the frontier of storms, a Forte of boundless might!

steps.name: A Commentator
steps.text: Put your hands together fooooor... independent knight... DIIIKAAAIOOPOOOLIIIS!!!

steps.name: A Spectator
steps.text: Oi, Minoan, your name is too hard to remember!

steps.name: A Spectator
steps.text: Cave the other guy's head in! I believe in you!

steps.name: Dikaiopolis
steps.text: ...... (Exhales)

steps.name: A Commentator
steps.text: Let the match–– BEGIIIIIN!!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: ...Listen, Minoan. You're an Infected.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: We've managed to hide it, and you've been able to scrounge up a bit of recognition in the underground arena.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Now there are several knightclubs in the Grand Knight Territory that are interested in you... This is a prime opportunity to make a lot of money.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: As long as you get noticed by one of those big-name knightclubs, we're gonna go to the moons, I tell you!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: But! There's no way they would let an Infected become a knight. In a small pond like ours, we might be able to hide it, but once we go to the Grand Knight Territory, it'll be too risky.

steps.name: Dikaiopolis
steps.text: So what's your plan?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: So! We pretend to sign a contract, then have you compete a few rounds and make some quick cash. Then we'll have you get 'injured' and withdraw from the tournament...

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: As for the official medical documentation, I'll try to grease some palms. We've gotta coordinate this thing perfectly! Right, Di–– Err...

steps.name: Dikaiopolis
steps.text: Just call me 'Minoan.'

steps.name: Dikaiopolis
steps.text: No need to remember my name.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: For your sake, you really should change your name to something strong and powerful-sounding, and easy to remember. Even a stage name is fine. You get me?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Let's get going! Onwards, to the Grand Knight Territory!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Unbelievable! Who would've expected this newcomer to take down Whitemaple Knight?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Look at that blood-red armor and that deadly crimson edge! He condensed his blood into a mighty weapon that even a swift and agile competitor like Whitemaple Knight could not evade!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Incredible strength! Awe-inspiring physique! Exceptional situational awareness! All in a sensational-looking package that is sure to sell!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: There's no need to wait for the judges! Without a shadow of a doubt, the winner is–– Blazingaxe Knight!

steps.name: Dikaiopolis
steps.text: *Pant*... *Pant*...

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Pffft––

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Th-The Major?!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Did you forget what we–– *cough* *cough*... Too many people here...

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: No way! Absolutely not! Do you remember how the previous champion ended up leaving Kazimierz?!

steps.name: Dikaiopolis
steps.text: ...Margaret Nearl, the Radiant Knight?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Yes, her! Born into a long line of heroes! The youngest champion in history! But did any of that add up to anything?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: One sentence – 'She's an Infected,' and she's expelled from Kazimierz. The entire Nearl family, gone like dust in the wind.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Don't joke around like that. We need to behave ourselves and––

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Sir, are you Blazingaxe Knight, Dikaiopolis?

steps.name: Dikaiopolis
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Oh, and who might you be...?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Are you... his manager?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Haha, something like that.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Ahh, wonderful. How fortunate.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: My name is Czarny, and I'm a spokesman for the General Chamber of Commerce.

steps.name: Dikaiopolis
steps.text: ...The Crimson Chalice Knightclub?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Yes... A knightclub established specifically for you.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: You are an Infected. But when it comes to managing public opinion, I always prefer dredging to blocking.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: What do you think about this title? 'Kazimierz's Blood-Red Chalice.' This will be your iconic advertising slogan.

steps.name: Dikaiopolis
steps.text: A chalice, huh. Such an elegant image doesn't suit someone as rough and unrefined as me.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Don't say that.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: As for the other members... It might even be possible to make an entire order of Infected knights. But that would depend on what happens next.

steps.name: Dikaiopolis
steps.text: Why would you go out of your way to do this? Aren't ordinary people afraid of the Infected?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: That's why 'ordinary people' never amount to anything.

steps.name: Dikaiopolis
steps.text: Then, if the Infected can become knights, why was the Radiant Knight exiled?

steps.name: Dikaiopolis
steps.text: How did the spectators feel about that?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: I do believe... that's where I come in, Dikaiopolis.

steps.name: A Commentator
steps.text: The second Infected knight to cut his way through the Major! From Minos, Dikaiopolis! Over the last two years, 'Kazimierz's Blood-Red Chalice' has become a household name!

steps.name: A Commentator
steps.text: Blazingaxe Knight's meteoric rise in both rank and popularity has been impossible to deny! His blood-red armor, his raw, visceral strength! He is, without a doubt, a true knight!

steps.name: A Commentator
steps.text: Next, let me introduce you to his opponent for this round... independent knight Viviana Droste––

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: The... Blood... Knight?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Yes. The Knights Association has just issued your official title.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Your proposal... a path for the Infected to gain official entry into the tournament, has been great reference material. As we speak, the Board is moving to make it a reality.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: You and your Crimson Chalice Knightclub may well be the pilots for this new program. At the same time, this is also a declaration to all the Infected in Kazimierz that we have not given up on them.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Hopefully, this can keep the Infected problem from boiling over.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Spokesman, will the Infected still face discrimination, even after becoming knights?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Unfortunately, they will. I can say this with near certainty.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: No matter when or where, people will always dread this disease. If you want them to change their views, you must resort to radical methods.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: If it's just the disease, there's nothing wrong with being afraid of a disease.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: But the Infected are also victims, and Infected knights are still knights.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Being a victim is also a part of the disease. As for the status of knighthood... Do you still not understand?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: The medical community has never stopped researching Oripathy, but... progress has been too slow. The general view is that Oripathy cannot be understood in our current theoretical framework...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: However, the good news is the Board of Directors is at least willing to meet with you and discuss your suggestions.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Come join my knightclub.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You... You're the champion?!

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Come with me, and we can live a normal life.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: But... we aren't that strong...

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: I don't need you to accomplish anything special... For them, just having me is good enough.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Ahaha... I thought I was going to get exiled, and die alone in the wilderness...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: But now, not I still stay in the city, and I can even stay in the same knightclub as the champion––

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: I'll lay down my life for you! Thank you! Thank you so much!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You are our saving grace, Blood Knight! Long live the Blood Knight!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Long live the Blood Knight!

a.text: Long live the Blood Knight! Long live the Blood Knight!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: ...Let's go.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You came here to get a glimpse of the Blood Knight?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Just a glimpse is enough.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We still have to follow our own path.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This is unbelievable! Can you believe your eyes?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Because I sure can't! The Radiant Knight has suddenly entered the fight! The Knights Association that let it happen! Oh my god, I, this—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: I've never seen a situation like this in all my years of commentating! Though I don't know how the National Council will react, it doesn't change the fact that they won!

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: So that... is the Radiant Knight...

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: For what reason... did you come back?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: This place is always bustling.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Congratulations on making the finals, Sir.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: The deciding battle between you and the Radiant Knight will be upon us soon. Afterwards, the championship ceremony will be held here, and the champion will personally memorialize the victory––

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: ––But, as you are the champion, this should all be familiar to you.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: The Major grows in size and scope each and every time. I don't like the bloated tournament formats and awards ceremonies you've tacked on.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Sorry about that.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Has the portrait of the Radiant Knight been hung back up?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Yes. The Knights Association has reaffirmed the Radiant Knight's status, and she has been reinstated as Kazimierz's champion.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: ...May I ask you a question?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Of course, spokesman.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You and the Radiant Knight are both Infected. What do you think of her?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: She is a magnificent failure.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Her defiance. Her willpower. Her formidable abilities. In these areas, she is magnificent.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: But because she accomplished nothing with all that... she is a failure.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: To demonstrate her conviction, or to maintain her glory, she allowed herself to be exiled, dragging her entire family down.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Was she really able to protect even a single person?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You don't seem to see eye-to-eye with her?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: These are two separate questions, spokesman.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Does she need me to see eye-to-eye?

steps.name: A Spectating Knight
steps.text: The finals! Now this is a matchup worth the money!

steps.name: A Spectating Knight
steps.text: The Blood Knight versus the Radiant Knight... I can't even imagine what kind of match this is going to be!!

steps.name: A Leithanian Noblewoman
steps.text: My, oh my. So this is Kazimierz's famous knights' banquet? I must say, it indeed lives up to its reputation.

steps.name: A Leithanian Noblewoman
steps.text: What kind of battle will we see between these two knights?

steps.name: A Leithanian Nobleman
steps.text: Haha, the land of the knights always has some surprises up its sleeves, madam. All we need to do is wait and see.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Just half an hour until the round starts!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: We've got a ton of spectators. Hey, use Section C as a guide for how to lead people in! Fill up Section I last!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Ah! Sorry, Sir, it's just too crowded––

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Don't worry.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Are our preparations complete? Good.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Remember what Malkiewicz said. Regardless of whether or not the Radiant Knight wins, add that line into the final announcement.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Rhodes Island? They came to watch the match too? I see, under the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi's name... That's fine.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Pay utmost attention to security. Also, keep an eye on the movement of the campaign knights.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Um, spokesman? Your further instructions?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Sorry... Give me a moment.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: ...Madam Droste.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: McKee.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: It's been a while. What can I do for you?
'I've let you down.'
But, those words do not escape his lips.
McKee's hand seems to be fumbling about in midair, as if trying to buy some leeway for his chagrin.
But in the end, he gives up.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: ...I hope you enjoy the finals.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: –– (Ancient language) The young hunter sets out on his Khaganquest ♪

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: –– (Ancient language) From dreams he goes, towards the shores of gold ♪
–– From dreams he goes, towards the shores of gold ♪
A halberd in hand, stained red with blood of kin ♪
Drowning in the bright moon's sorrow ♪
Until the black night paints over his vision ♪
Until a tower of bone stands erect in his heart ♪
Until hemlock chokes his hazy home ♪
O, the hunter is bound to flame by ashes ♪
O, the hunter's soul sleeps in the eye of the spring ♪
From the lighthouse did the longbow loose ♪ But with its arrows of bonfires and dawn ♪
Upon the dead has the bone urn been splashed ♪ But the father still waters white cocoons under the tree ♪

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We made it! But, it's so crowded! Though you could've guessed that just from what was on TV.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah!

options: Stay close to me. Don't get separated in the crowd.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Over here, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Nightingale, you should be careful as well.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Right now, it's exactly 8 o'clock in the Grand Knight Territory! Welcome to the 24th Grand Finals of the Kazimierz Major! As always, it's your old buddy Greatmouth Mob here!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: After countless hardships and struggles, after countless victories and defeats, Kazimierz will, tonight, crown yet another champion after three long years!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Don't expect much sleep in the land of Kazimierz tonight! A new hero and a new legend will be born!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Countless eyes are on us from all over the world! Knight enthusiasts from Columbia, Victoria, Leithanien, you name it, all are paying rapt attention to tonight's match!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And tonight's match, yes, in a single night, will shatter countless records! The number of concurrent viewers! The total amount of traffic! Single-day sales!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: ––But that's not all! The most, most, most, most important thing of all... are the knights! Take a good look, every single one of you lucky spectators! Tonight, even the Minoan goddess of war will have to concede!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: For the first time in over two decades, two champions will clash in the grand finals!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Two champions! Two of the greatest knights Kazimierz has ever seen!! Anybody lucky enough to be here to witness this historic event—make sure to etch every moment of this night into your memory!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Because from now on, you all will be a part of the greatest moment in the history of the Kazimierz Major!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The two contenders for the championship require no introduction! But rules are rules, so I've got to waste a few of your precious minutes! First, let me introduce you to––

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The defending Champion of the Major, 'Kazimierz's Blood-Red Chalice,' the Blood Knight of the Crimson Chalice Knightclub –– DIKAAAAAAIOOOPOLIIIIIIS!
A suit of crimson armor emerges from the shadows and takes its place beneath the light.
The hero has no flashy moves. He simply stands in the arena, feeling the temperature of the soil and the humidity of the air.
The Blood Knight lifts his head slightly. He can hardly see the night sky from beneath the blinding array of light.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight!

steps.name: A Spectating Knight
steps.text: The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Blood Knight. He is the one who created a path to knighthood for the Infected?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I had no idea... he was this kind of warrior.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Just listen to those deafening cheers.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Shining, he's the one they call their hero?

options: Even if we know very little about him, I can't deny that he is a hero.
Even if he stands in Nearl's way, I can't deny he's a tough opponent.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And on the other side!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The young legend! The heir of a great hero! Bearer of a thousand glories and former occupant of the Throne of Champions, only to be exiled in the blink of an eye! A tragedy in the hearts of countless people!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: But none of that matters now! She is the youngest champion in the history of the Major, the quickest to achieve the rank of Grand Knight, an independent knight who rose to the highest honor in the land––

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The legend on everyone's lips... now walks before us once more! Please welcome the light-bringing pegasus, the Radiant Knight––MAAAARGAREEEEEET NEEEAAAAAAAARRRLLL!!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Two Infected, two champions, two Grand Knights! This match will be one for the history books! A matchup so exciting your heart might leap out of your chest!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: It's now my pleasure to announce...

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The deciding Grand Finals of the 24th Kazimierz Major! BEGIN––

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Wh-What's going on?! The Blood Knight suddenly took off his helmet! This usually only happens after the match is decided––!

steps.name: The Radiant Knight
steps.text: You...

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: The Radiant Knight. I'm very glad you've made it here.

steps.name: The Radiant Knight
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: A lot of people do not understand your choices, but I do.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: You wish to become a beacon. You know that you alone cannot tear down this era–– And if you could, it would be meaningless.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Therefore, you cast your own light forth to illuminate a path forward for others, in the hope that those who are forced to kneel will straighten their backs, to let the oppressed choose their own destinies.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Your dedication is most honorable, Radiant Knight. From your eyes, I cannot see even a speck of the so-called dust of ideals.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Many heroes do strive to act out of justice, but do it too hastily, in a way that is only self-serving.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: No, I was surprised.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: After I returned to Kazimierz, I met a number of knights who still held onto their faith.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: They haven't lost themselves to modernity. From them, I can still see the embers of glory flickering.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Virtue will always exist. This city is not so rotten to that extent, but––

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: ––Virtue alone cannot change this era.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: On this decadent knights' stage, there is only one thing I want to prove.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: That even now, true knights still exist.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: That beauty, honor, and justice... still exist here––

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: ––Indeed, those things, that spirit, are like gems. You illuminate those gems, and wait for others to pick them up again.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: That is your greatest limitation, Margaret.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Dedication, sacrifice, and fighting for justice are of course noble and righteous. For this, I admire you.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: But these things, the spirit of knighthood, may not be enough to save this complex era.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: You handed a pickaxe to the weak and taught them to break down walls of stone. But you never taught them how to build a new home.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Or rather–– You never told them: While they can choose a new path, there are many different paths they can take.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Nngh––!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The Blood Knight suddenly launches the first attack! In terms of range, the Radiant Knight's swordspear should undoubtedly have the advantage! But right now–– Wait a minute!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: It's Blood Arts! After the axe swing, he's immediately following up with a spear of blood from his left hand––?!

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: (She blocked it––?)

steps.name: The Radiant Knight
steps.text: I'm not done yet!

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Guh!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: A burst of light! It's the Radiant Knight's Arts! In the opening moments of the match, it's an Arts against Arts showdown! I can't see what's going on, but the two are clearly already going at it hard!

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: What precise Arts control, and to throw it out so instantly... Unbelievable.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: This couldn't have been achieved through ordinary training... No, there's no way you can learn skills like this from the arena...

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Is it military training? Fighting rampaging beasts on the wastelands?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: I can say this for sure, Margaret. You now shine like the sun in the sky.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: ––In every duel you fight... Against the Nightzmora, against the Candle Knight... Are you always this calm?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Look at you. This is the first time I've seen your expression on the battlefield––

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: My expression?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Much less burdened than I expected, Blood Knight.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I've given it some thought as well. If I returned to the arena only to see decadence and decay, whether or not I'd be shaken.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But now, I am firm in my beliefs.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Though we should probably put that conversation aside for another time.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Agreed.
The eyes of the two knights meet.
The power beneath their armor roils restlessly, strong convictions flaring in their hearts.
Now is not the time to talk about the future.
Now is the time to decide a winner.
